shop_settings_days.name: shop_settings_days
shop_settings_days.value: "shop_settings"."return_days" between 0 and 60 and "shop_settings"."dispatch_days" between 0 and 30 and "shop_settings"."metro_days" between 0 and 30 and "shop_settings"."rest_days" between 0 and 30

shop_settings_ship_costs.name: shop_settings_ship_costs
shop_settings_ship_costs.value:
("shop_settings"."ship_cost_delivery" is null or "shop_settings"."ship_cost_delivery" between 0 and 1000000) and ("shop_settings"."ship_cost_return" is null or "shop_settings"."ship_cost_return" between 0 and 1000000)
    and ("shop_settings"."ship_cost_cod" is null or "shop_settings"."ship_cost_cod" between 0 and 1000000)
    and ("shop_settings"."ship_costs_confirmed_at" is null or ("shop_settings"."ship_cost_delivery" is not null and "shop_settings"."ship_cost_return" is not null and "shop_settings"."ship_cost_cod" is not null))

tenant_plans_custom_reason.name: tenant_plans_custom_reason
tenant_plans_custom_reason.value: "tenant_plans"."custom_monthly_price" is null or "tenant_plans"."reason" is not null

variants_money.name: variants_money
variants_money.value: "variants"."price" >= 0 and ("variants"."compare_at" is null or "variants"."compare_at" >= 0) and ("variants"."unit_cost" is null or "variants"."unit_cost" >= 0)

variants_lead.name: variants_lead
variants_lead.value: "variants"."when_out" <> 'made_to_order' or ("variants"."lead_min_days" between 1 and 120 and "variants"."lead_max_days" between "variants"."lead_min_days" and 120)

order_events_who.name: order_events_who
order_events_who.value: ("order_events"."actor_kind" = 'system') = ("order_events"."actor_user_id" is null) and ("order_events"."actor_user_id" is null) = ("order_events"."actor_email" is null)

order_lines_money.name: order_lines_money
order_lines_money.value: "order_lines"."unit_price" >= 0 and "order_lines"."taxable_value" >= 0 and "order_lines"."gst" >= 0 and "order_lines"."line_discount" >= 0 and "order_lines"."product_discount" >= 0 and "order_lines"."product_discount" <= "order_lines"."line_discount" and ("order_lines"."unit_cost" is null or "order_lines"."unit_cost" >= 0)

orders_tenant_holds.name: orders_tenant_holds
orders_tenant_holds.where: "orders"."paid_at" is null and "orders"."cancelled_at" is null and "orders"."pay_by" is not null

orders_inflight_idx.name: orders_inflight_idx
orders_inflight_idx.where: "orders"."rto_delivered_at" is null and ("orders"."rto_initiated_at" is not null or ("orders"."delivered_at" is null and "orders"."lost_at" is null and "orders"."cancelled_at" is null and ("orders"."packed_at" is not null or "orders"."shipped_at" is not null or "orders"."ndr_at" is not null)))

orders_freight.name: orders_freight
orders_freight.value: ("orders"."forward_shipping" is null or "orders"."forward_shipping" >= 0) and ("orders"."rto_shipping" is null or "orders"."rto_shipping" >= 0) and ("orders"."courier_cod_fee" is null or "orders"."courier_cod_fee" >= 0)

orders_cancel_reason.name: orders_cancel_reason
orders_cancel_reason.value: "orders"."cancel_reason" is null or ("orders"."cancelled_at" is not null and "orders"."cancel_reason" in ('fake','customer_cancelled','unreachable','out_of_stock','cant_deliver','other'))

shipments_text.name: shipments_text
shipments_text.value: ("shipments"."courier_name" is null or length("shipments"."courier_name") between 1 and 60) and ("shipments"."tracking_number" is null or length("shipments"."tracking_number") between 1 and 40)

shipments_ended.name: shipments_ended
shipments_ended.value: ("shipments"."ended_at" is null) = ("shipments"."ended_reason" is null) and ("shipments"."ended_reason" is null or "shipments"."ended_reason" in ('cancelled','undone'))

partners_decided_once.name: partners_decided_once
partners_decided_once.value: not ("partners"."approved_at" is not null and "partners"."declined_at" is not null)

tenant_addons_paid_or_trial.name: tenant_addons_paid_or_trial
tenant_addons_paid_or_trial.value: ("tenant_addons"."addon_price_id" is not null) <> ("tenant_addons"."trial_ends_at" is not null)

wa_connections_ids.name: wa_connections_ids
wa_connections_ids.value: waba_id ~ '^[0-9]{5,20}$' and phone_number_id ~ '^[0-9]{5,20}$' and (business_id is null or business_id ~ '^[0-9]{5,20}$')

wa_connections_closed.name: wa_connections_closed
wa_connections_closed.value: ("wa_connections"."disconnected_at" is null) = ("wa_connections"."disconnected_by" is null) and ("wa_connections"."disconnected_at" is null) = ("wa_connections"."token_enc" is not null)

discount_codes_label.name: discount_codes_label
discount_codes_label.value: "discount_codes"."label" is null or length("discount_codes"."label") between 1 and 40

discount_tiers_value.name: discount_tiers_value
discount_tiers_value.value:
("discount_tiers"."percent_bps" is null) <> ("discount_tiers"."amount_off" is null) and ("discount_tiers"."percent_bps" is null or "discount_tiers"."percent_bps" between 1 and 10000)
    and ("discount_tiers"."amount_off" is null or "discount_tiers"."amount_off" > 0) and "discount_tiers"."min_subtotal" > 0

discounts_tenant_live.name: discounts_tenant_live
discounts_tenant_live.where: "discounts"."started_at" is not null and "discounts"."ended_at" is null

discounts_one_announce.name: discounts_one_announce
discounts_one_announce.where: "discounts"."announce" and "discounts"."started_at" is not null and "discounts"."ended_at" is null

discounts_value.name: discounts_value
discounts_value.value:
case "discounts"."style"
    when 'free_shipping' then "discounts"."percent_bps" is null and "discounts"."amount_off" is null and "discounts"."cap" is null
    when 'bxgy' then "discounts"."percent_bps" is null and "discounts"."amount_off" is null and "discounts"."buy_qty" between 1 and 10 and "discounts"."get_qty" between 1 and 10 and "discounts"."get_bps" between 1 and 10000
    when 'free_gift' then "discounts"."percent_bps" is null and "discounts"."amount_off" is null
    when 'order_off' then not ("discounts"."percent_bps" is not null and "discounts"."amount_off" is not null)
    else ("discounts"."percent_bps" is null) <> ("discounts"."amount_off" is null) end

discounts_money.name: discounts_money
discounts_money.value:
("discounts"."percent_bps" is null or "discounts"."percent_bps" between 1 and 10000) and ("discounts"."amount_off" is null or "discounts"."amount_off" > 0)
    and ("discounts"."cap" is null or "discounts"."cap" > 0) and "discounts"."min_subtotal" >= 0 and ("discounts"."budget" is null or "discounts"."budget" > 0)
    and ("discounts"."limit_total" is null or "discounts"."limit_total" > 0) and ("discounts"."limit_per_phone" is null or "discounts"."limit_per_phone" > 0)

discounts_stopped.name: discounts_stopped
discounts_stopped.value:
("discounts"."stopped_at" is null) = ("discounts"."stopped_by" is null) and ("discounts"."stopped_at" is null) = ("discounts"."stop_reason" is null)
    and ("discounts"."stop_reason" is null or length("discounts"."stop_reason") between 3 and 300)

theme_versions_baseline_stays.name: theme_versions_baseline_stays
theme_versions_baseline_stays.value: not ("theme_versions"."theme_key" = 'classic' and "theme_versions"."version" = '1.0.0' and ("theme_versions"."recalled_at" is not null or "theme_versions"."withdrawn_at" is not null))

theme_versions_reasons.name: theme_versions_reasons
theme_versions_reasons.value: ("theme_versions"."recalled_at" is null or length("theme_versions"."recalled_reason") between 3 and 300) and ("theme_versions"."withdrawn_at" is null or length("theme_versions"."withdrawn_reason") between 3 and 300)

videos_ids.name: videos_ids
videos_ids.value: ("videos"."upload_id" is null or "videos"."upload_id" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,128}$') and ("videos"."asset_id" is null or "videos"."asset_id" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,128}$') and ("videos"."playback_id" is null or "videos"."playback_id" ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9]{1,64}$')

videos_error.name: videos_error
videos_error.value: ("videos"."errored_at" is null) = ("videos"."error" is null) and ("videos"."error" is null or length("videos"."error") <= 40)

videos_size.name: videos_size
videos_size.value: ("videos"."width" is null or "videos"."width" between 1 and 8192) and ("videos"."height" is null or "videos"."height" between 1 and 8192) and ("videos"."duration_ms" is null or "videos"."duration_ms" between 0 and 43200000)

videos_playable.name: videos_playable
videos_playable.value: "videos"."mp4_ready_at" is null or ("videos"."ready_at" is not null and "videos"."playback_id" is not null)

frrata_invoices_issued.name: frrata_invoices_issued
frrata_invoices_issued.value: "frrata_invoices"."number" is null or "frrata_invoices"."issued_at" is not null

frrata_payments_outcome.name: frrata_payments_outcome
frrata_payments_outcome.value: not ("frrata_payments"."captured_at" is not null and "frrata_payments"."failed_at" is not null)

gst_filings_filed.name: gst_filings_filed
gst_filings_filed.value: ("gst_filings"."filed_at" is null) = ("gst_filings"."arn" is null) and ("gst_filings"."filed_at" is null) = ("gst_filings"."filed_by" is null)

shop_domains_live.name: shop_domains_live
shop_domains_live.where: proved_at is not null and removed_at is null

shop_domains_live_apex.name: shop_domains_live_apex
shop_domains_live_apex.where: proved_at is not null and removed_at is null

shop_domains_main.name: shop_domains_main
shop_domains_main.where: main_at is not null and removed_at is null

shop_domains_due.name: shop_domains_due
shop_domains_due.where: removed_at is null or parked_at is not null

shop_domains_host.name: shop_domains_host
shop_domains_host.value:
"shop_domains"."host" = lower("shop_domains"."host") and "shop_domains"."host" !~ '\.$' and length("shop_domains"."host") between 4 and 253 and "shop_domains"."host" ~ '^[a-z0-9.-]+$'
    and "shop_domains"."host" !~ '^www\.' and "shop_domains"."host" !~ '(^|\.)(frrata|frata)\.' and "shop_domains"."host" !~ '(^|\.)vercel\.app$'
    and "shop_domains"."host" ~ '^([a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?\.)+[a-z0-9]([a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?$'
    and ("shop_domains"."host" = "shop_domains"."apex" or "shop_domains"."host" like '%.' || "shop_domains"."apex")

shop_domains_main_needs.name: shop_domains_main_needs
shop_domains_main_needs.value: "shop_domains"."main_at" is null or ("shop_domains"."proved_at" is not null and "shop_domains"."cert_ok_at" is not null)

shop_domains_after_proof.name: shop_domains_after_proof
shop_domains_after_proof.value: "shop_domains"."proved_at" is not null or ("shop_domains"."added_at" is null and "shop_domains"."dns_ok_at" is null and "shop_domains"."cert_ok_at" is null and "shop_domains"."razorpay_ok_at" is null and "shop_domains"."main_at" is null)

shop_domains_parked.name: shop_domains_parked
shop_domains_parked.value: "shop_domains"."parked_at" is null or "shop_domains"."removed_at" is not null

shop_names_current.name: shop_names_current
shop_names_current.where: retired_at is null and added_at is null

shop_names_added.name: shop_names_added
shop_names_added.where: added_at is not null and retired_at is null

shop_names_added_live.name: shop_names_added_live
shop_names_added_live.value: "shop_names"."added_at" is null or ("shop_names"."retired_at" is null and not "shop_names"."retired_by_frrata")

ekcode_consents_kind.name: ekcode_consents_kind
ekcode_consents_kind.value: ("ekcode_consents"."kind" = 'network' and "ekcode_consents"."tenant_id" is null) or ("ekcode_consents"."kind" = 'share' and "ekcode_consents"."tenant_id" is not null)

review_requests_remind.name: review_requests_remind
review_requests_remind.where: "review_requests"."reminded_at" is null and "review_requests"."sent_at" is not null

reviews_held.name: reviews_held
reviews_held.where: "reviews"."held_at" is not null and "reviews"."approved_at" is null and "reviews"."hidden_at" is null

reviews_text.name: reviews_text
reviews_text.value: length("reviews"."title") <= 100 and length("reviews"."body") <= 2000 and length("reviews"."reply") <= 1000 and length("reviews"."display_name") between 1 and 60

reviews_held_reason.name: reviews_held_reason
reviews_held_reason.value: ("reviews"."held_at" is null) = ("reviews"."held_reason" is null) and ("reviews"."held_reason" is null or "reviews"."held_reason" in ('language','spam','approve_each','photos'))

reviews_hidden_reason.name: reviews_hidden_reason
reviews_hidden_reason.value: ("reviews"."hidden_at" is null) = ("reviews"."hidden_reason" is null) and ("reviews"."hidden_reason" is null or "reviews"."hidden_reason" in ('abuse','not_about_product','personal_data','spam','unlawful','contact'))
